rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. GEAR Fighter Dendoh or Knight GEAR Ogre lost@2. Allied mothership shot down
rows.notes: Loss conditions; preserve two fixed plain lines and either unit lost. Draft first line measured 363px; shot down -> lost yields 320px, retaining both full unit names and either-unit loss.

rows.en: We've successfully entered the space around Spiral Castle!
rows.notes: Megumi reports arrival to the bridge; entry succeeded, no landing implied.

rows.en: Match our velocity to the target's!
rows.notes: Bright orders the bridge to match relative velocity; Saegusa's omitted fresh acknowledgment follows in full147.

rows.en: Roger!
How is the battle going in the other sectors!?
rows.notes: Bright asks bridge staff for the other space sectors' situation.

rows.en: Our allies are under some enemy pressure, but they've cut the enemy off from Spiral Castle's sector!
rows.notes: Linda reports other allied forces holding the enemy apart from the castle sector; full150 confirms preventing a pincer. Root final clarification explicitly names allies and enemy to prevent repeated they/them pronouns reversing the report. Original adjacent Bright question and pincer inference settle direction.
uncertain: The two omitted subjects in the report are resolved as other allied forces and the enemy from Bright's question and pincer inference.

rows.en: Then there's little chance of us being caught in a pincer attack...!
rows.notes: Bright draws a tactical conclusion from Linda's report; little chance remains less than certainty.

rows.en: But this is the enemy's headquarters... They'll clearly try to overwhelm us with numbers.
rows.notes: Misato cautions Bright about superior enemy numbers at their stronghold.

rows.en: I know. ...Major Katsuragi, we're moving to Phase 3 of Operation Screw Nail.
rows.notes: Bright addresses Misato by surname and sourced Major rank; full153 acknowledges this order.
uncertain: Operation Screw Nail is the glossary's source-backed provisional title; exact licensed wording unverified.

rows.en: Understood.
All units... Launch immediately!
rows.notes: Bright orders the pilots to deploy immediately.

rows.en: Harry, how long until Spiral Castle reaches the interception limit... the Zero Barrier?
rows.notes: Ruri asks Hari for time to the named interception limit. Root confirmed source-backed literal terms; no forcefield, ability or orbital-physics inference. Coordinator name script: Existing source-scoped spoken nickname Harry; frozen Hari speaker unchanged. Initial full draft retained; no compression.
uncertain: Zero Barrier and interception limit are source-backed literal terms; exact licensed wording unverified.

rows.en: Twenty-eight minutes left! After that, Spiral Castle will fall into the atmosphere!
rows.notes: Hari answers Ruri with the remaining time and consequence after that threshold.

rows.en: It feels like we have time, but we don't... It's kind of an awkward amount.
rows.notes: Hikaru comments to the team on the neither-long-nor-short time remaining.

rows.en: No, fighting the Vegan Empire delayed our arrival beyond schedule... We'd better assume we have no time or room to spare.
rows.notes: Kamille corrects Hikaru; the battle delayed arrival and the team should act without time or margin.

rows.en: Yeah. If that thing hits Earth, it'll do as much damage as a colony drop... No, even more...!
rows.notes: Judau agrees with Kamille; preserves escalation from colony-drop equivalence to worse.

rows.en: What's more, it can change where it lands to some extent, of its own will...
rows.notes: Amuro identifies the castle's limited ability to choose its impact point; uses neutral it for machine.

rows.en: If it falls on the Japan area, where TOKYO JUPITER and NERV Headquarters are, there's no telling what else might happen.
rows.notes: Amuro warns of additional unknown consequences if it hits Japan, naming both locations.

rows.en: Damn...! If we had the mass driver at a time like this, it might make things a little easier.
rows.notes: Tapp wishes they still had the mass driver, with limited and hypothetical benefit.

rows.en: Don't say things like that. Do you know how much trouble we went through going to destroy it?
rows.notes: Roux scolds Tapp about their effort getting to the mass driver, not a claim that they destroyed it themselves.

rows.en: S-sorry...
rows.notes: Tapp gives Roux a stammered apology; intentional conversational fragment.

rows.en: Well, actually, it was already destroyed by the time we got to the Giganos base.
rows.notes: Drill corrects the technical detail of the mass driver's destruction, prompting Roux's rebuke.

rows.en: That's not what I'm talking about!
rows.notes: Roux tells Drill the literal destruction detail misses her point; restores speaker subject and verb.

rows.en: S-sorry...
rows.notes: Drill echoes Tapp's stammered apology; intentional conversational fragment.

rows.en: ...Everyone, listen. Once you're inside Spiral Castle, find the reactor and destroy it right away.
rows.notes: Misato addresses all pilots with the immediate interior mission; reactor does not add nuclear or power-core lore.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Kamille acknowledges the order; conventional response retained.

rows.en: ...Let's go, Ginga. Are you ready?
rows.notes: Hokuto checks Ginga's readiness after the orders; explicit listener.

rows.en: Yeah! Let's give it our all for Altair, too!
rows.notes: Ginga answers Hokuto; also preserves the additional motive of fighting for Altair.

rows.en: Right! With my Ogre and your Dendoh... Let's stop Spiral Castle together with everyone!
rows.notes: Hokuto names each pilot's machine ownership and includes the rest of the team.

rows.en: Brother, please watch over us. I'll protect Earth from Spiral Castle together with those children...!
rows.notes: Vega's private thought addresses her brother Altair. Keeps Brother rather than injecting a name; thought brackets measured.

rows.en: Heh, my blood is boiling... It reminds me of our final battle against the Devil Gundam.
rows.notes: Kyral reflects to Argo on battle excitement and their previous final battle, not a new Devil Gundam here.

rows.en: Yeah, it certainly does.
rows.notes: Argo agrees with Kyral's battle recollection; complete conversational answer.

rows.en: Let's go, everyone! Let's save our Earth from Gulfer's clutches!
rows.notes: Duke rallies the whole team; canonical Gulfer organization spelling.

rows.en: Yeah!!
rows.notes: Kazuya answers the rally with a loud affirmative.

rows.en: Then... Phase 3 of Operation Screw Nail begins now!
rows.notes: Misato formally starts the phase, echoing Bright's order.
uncertain: Operation Screw Nail is the glossary's source-backed provisional title; exact licensed wording unverified.

rows.en: Just you wait, Spiral Castle! We're coming for you right now!!
rows.notes: Ginga challenges the castle; collective subject follows Hokuto and the team's launch.

rows.en: D-damn you! How dare mere humans do this to me!!
rows.notes: Battle defeat speech attacks humans' lowly status and maintains the insult. Leaves the unspecified injury as this; does not reveal a mechanism.
uncertain: Retains source omission of exactly what humans did, using this; paired full181 repeats the outraged object.

rows.en: To meeee! Gwaaaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Continuation of prior defeat row repeats me before the death cry; intentional fragment and matching reveal order.
uncertain: Intentional repeated object fragment continues fresh32 rather than adding a guessed verb.

rows.en: I-impossible! Feeble humans, defeating me?!
rows.notes: Witter defeat event; shocked arrogance, weakness insult retained.

rows.en: Gwaaaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Witter death cry follows defeat; nonlexical shout retained.

rows.en: ...Cannot... grasp... Cannot grasp... What... must be protected...? What must be protected? What... must hu...mans pro...tect...?
rows.notes: Castle defeat event; glitching questions about what humans protect; repeated query and machine failure retained. Measured four-line draft compressed only comprehend to grasp; all three questions, both inability assertions, and deliberate glitches retained.

rows.en: Everyone has a different answer, but I'll tell you what Hokuto and I think.
rows.notes: Ginga answers Castle, introducing his and Hokuto's individual answer without claiming universality.

rows.en: What... is it... that you... must pro...tect...?
rows.notes: Castle asks both boys; deliberate glitches retained.

rows.en: ...Our promises.
rows.notes: Hokuto answers Castle's query; deliberate short answer noun fragment.

rows.en: ...Pro...mises...?
rows.notes: Castle echoes Hokuto's answer; deliberate question fragment and glitch.

rows.en: I promised Mom... that I'd come home, no matter what.
rows.notes: Ginga answers with promise to his own mother; return commitment is unconditional.

rows.en: I promised my mom, too... that I'd protect the Earth.
rows.notes: Hokuto adds promise to his own mother; Earth protection stated, no mother identity reveal added.

rows.en: Hokuto... Ginga...!
rows.notes: Vega reacts to boys; deliberate vocative fragment, source honorific dropped.

rows.en: It's not just Mom. I've made important promises to everyone else, too.
rows.notes: Ginga broadens promises to other people; important retained.

rows.en: That's why we'll keep them. For everyone... and for ourselves.
rows.notes: Hokuto refers to promises; keep protects the promise sense, both beneficiaries retained.

rows.en: Absurd... Protecting something without physical form... Cannot comprehend... Cannot comprehend...!
rows.notes: Castle rejects intangible things; physical form meaning and repeated failure retained.

rows.en: Cannot... comprehend...!!
rows.notes: Castle final failure; deliberate broken machine fragment.

rows.en: If you wish to stop Spiral Castle, you must defeat me.
rows.notes: Witter battle conversation addresses attacker; explicit condition retained.

rows.en: Assuming you can, of course!
rows.notes: Witter continues previous taunt; deliberate dependent fragment.

rows.en: We can! That's what we came here for!
rows.notes: Hokuto answers Witter's taunt with confidence and purpose.

rows.en: Yeah! We believe in our own strength... Strength that'll never lose!!
rows.notes: Ginga supports Hokuto; strength and invincibility assertion retained.

rows.en: You humans! I won't let you through here!!
rows.notes: Absolute challenges attackers; prohibition restored as first-person intention.

rows.en: You think saying that will make us turn around and go home?!
rows.notes: Ginga rejects Absolute's demand; turn-around-and-leave image retained.

rows.en: If that's how you want it, we'll just force our way through!!
rows.notes: Hokuto threatens forcing passage through Absolute's blockade.

rows.en: Here we come, big boss!
rows.notes: Ginga initiates battle against Castle's master; source-short generic boss, no named lore expansion.

rows.en: We'll defeat you and stop Spiral Castle, no matter what!!
rows.notes: Hokuto follows Ginga; defeat Castle master to stop castle, emphatic certainty.

rows.en: I cannot comprehend... Why do you keep fighting when you know you will lose...?
rows.notes: Castle questions boys' continued fighting; its assumed foreknowledge of defeat is retained.

rows.en: Your annihilation was already determined when Gulfer arrived here...
rows.notes: Castle continues fatalistic claim; Gulfer arrival and preordained annihilation.

rows.en: That's an ending you decided on all by yourselves!
rows.notes: Hokuto rejects enemies' unilateral conclusion, referring to prior fatalistic assertion.

rows.en: We won't lose... No, we can't afford to lose!
rows.notes: Ginga corrects won't lose to cannot afford to lose, source self-correction retained.

rows.en: For everyone fighting alongside us to defeat you...
rows.notes: Hokuto begins reason for not losing, completed by Ginga in next row; deliberate fragment.

rows.en: And for the people on Earth who believe we'll win!
rows.notes: Ginga completes reason across speaker change; supporters on Earth believe in victory.

rows.en: Oyakata-sama or a damn kettle, I don't care! Once we beat you, it's all over! Get ready!!
rows.notes: Koji taunts Castle master. Fixed Oyakata-sama retained; source o-yakan/kettle sound joke rendered literally as kettle insult. Defeat ends everything, threat preserved.
uncertain: Japanese Oyakata/o-yakan sound pun has no equivalent with fixed Oyakata-sama; kettle joke is a literal adaptation.

rows.en: Such a reckless charge... Why do humans fight with no regard for themselves...?
rows.notes: Castle responds to Koji's charge; self-regard means own wellbeing, not moral introspection.

rows.en: I'll tell you! This is what we call human courage!!
rows.notes: Koji answers Castle with courage assertion.

rows.en: Why... Why do humans fight when they know they will lose...?
rows.notes: Castle repeats central question to Tetsuya in a separate battle exchange.

rows.en: I'll tell you, you mechanical bastard! It's for our pride!
rows.notes: Tetsuya answers Castle with pride and crude machine-directed insult; next row adds certainty of victory.

rows.en: And here's one more thing! We haven't even considered the possibility of losing!!
rows.notes: Tetsuya to Spiral Castle; continues his pride answer from fresh 67. Explicit we and absolute rejection of defeat restored.

rows.en: So you want to know what people fight for!
rows.notes: Duke to Spiral Castle; begins his battle exchange. Restores second-person question from the asserted desire to know.

rows.en: Do you know the answer, prince of Planet Fleed?
rows.notes: Spiral Castle answers Duke. Planet Fleed and princely address retained.

rows.en: For love! You would never understand... the human heart that fights for those it loves!
rows.notes: Duke answers fresh 70; love motivates people fighting for loved ones. Explicit subject restored.

rows.en: Humans, you recklessly challenge me to battle. Learn just how powerless you are!
rows.notes: Spiral Castle challenges Getter team; labels their attack reckless and threatens humiliation.

rows.en: That machine boss sure says whatever it pleases!
rows.notes: Hayato responds to Spiral Castle threat; dismissive machine-boss insult retained.

rows.en: Ryo, Hayato! Let's show it where our strength comes from!
rows.notes: Benkei addresses Ryo and Hayato; invites showing the enemy their shared source of strength. Source nickname Ryo retained.

rows.en: Let's go! I'll make you, a machine, feel the power born of the bonds between the three of us... between people!
rows.notes: Ryoma addresses Spiral Castle; three-person bond expands to interpersonal bonds. Ellipsis retained at that expansion.

rows.en: You want to know what we fight for? A machine like you will probably never understand!
rows.notes: Akira addresses Spiral Castle; rhetorical question followed by probable eternal incomprehension.

rows.en: What is that answer?
rows.notes: Spiral Castle asks Akira to identify his answer; complete question restored.

rows.en: There are people waiting for us on Earth... Their trust gives us the strength to fight!
rows.notes: Akira answers fresh 77; Earth people wait for the team and their trust powers its fight.

rows.en: You would never understand what it means to fight for what we must protect... for what we must love!
rows.notes: Kazuya addresses Spiral Castle; things to protect and love retained without narrowing them to an identified person.

rows.en: Those you love...?
rows.notes: Spiral Castle echoes unfamiliar love concept; purposeful question fragment retained.
uncertain: Source echo-question fragment preserved.

rows.en: That's right! My fists exist to protect those I love! Now you can feel their power, too!
rows.notes: Kazuya answers fresh 80; fists protect loved ones, and enemy will experience their strength.

rows.en: Do you understand why we're coming at you, Lord of Spiral Castle!
rows.notes: Domon addresses Lord of Spiral Castle; complete rhetorical question restores why the team challenges it.

rows.en: Unable to comprehend... This man... why does he come at me...
rows.notes: Spiral Castle considers Domon; machine comprehension fragment and trailing question retained. Source explicitly calls Domon a man.
uncertain: Source machine-comprehension fragment and trailing question preserved.

rows.en: Then I'll teach you! My fists hold friendship, trust... and the hope of living for the future!!
rows.notes: Domon answers fresh 83; fists embody friendship, trust and hope to live into the future. Copular structure restored; no item omitted.

rows.en: We may both be mechanical life forms, but there's a great difference between you and us...
rows.notes: Rom to Spiral Castle; both are mechanical life forms, but fundamentally differ. Plural us maintained.

rows.en: Is that the thing you call a... heart...
rows.notes: Spiral Castle to Rom; unfamiliar heart concept echoed without adding a soul claim.
uncertain: Source unfamiliar-concept echo with trailing ellipsis preserved.

rows.en: That's right!
rows.notes: Rom confirms fresh 86. Complete affirmation.

rows.en: Foolish... What use could that possibly be in battle...
rows.notes: Spiral Castle dismisses Rom; questions practical utility of heart in battle, trailing contemplation retained.

rows.en: You still don't understand, Spiral Castle! Fighting without ever giving up... That's the strength of our hearts!
rows.notes: Rom answers fresh 88; fighting without ever giving up manifests heart strength.

rows.en: And the power those hearts create will surely strike you down!
rows.notes: Rom continues fresh 89; power generated by hearts is guaranteed to defeat the enemy.

rows.en: You should understand. Even if you destroy me, that will not be the end.
rows.notes: Spiral Castle addresses Vega, whose next response settles direction; destruction will not end the conflict. No later army reveal introduced.

rows.en: Even if that's true, we won't give up...! We believe that's what makes humans strong!!
rows.notes: Vega answers fresh 91; refusing to give up is believed to be human strength. Explicit we restored.

rows.en: A machine could never understand the power the human heart creates!
rows.notes: Male protagonist to Spiral Castle; human heart power contrasted with machines. Placeholder prefix retained.

rows.en: The power of the heart?
rows.notes: Spiral Castle echoes fresh 93; purposeful questioning fragment.
uncertain: Source echo-question fragment preserved.

rows.en: Love, courage, hatred, ambition... The human heart is the source of limitless power...
rows.notes: Female protagonist to Spiral Castle; all four emotions and limitless generating power retained. Trailing ellipsis preserved.

rows.en: And the hearts within us that will never forgive you!
rows.notes: Male protagonist begins subject phrase whose predicate arrives in fresh 97. Intentionally unfinished across speakers.
uncertain: Source unfinished subject phrase preserved; shared predicate is supplied by fresh row 97.

rows.en: The hearts that want to protect Earth will surely seize victory!!
rows.notes: Female protagonist completes paired subjects from fresh 96; Earth-protecting hearts will certainly win.

rows.en: Captain! Our units have successfully entered Spiral Castle!
rows.notes: Megumi reports to Bright; tactical trigger changes to successful allied entry.

rows.en: Relay the video from inside to us and every unit!
rows.notes: Bright orders Megumi/bridge to relay interior images to bridge and each unit. No guessed hardware added.

rows.en: Just as we figured, it's an ambush!
rows.notes: Koji reacts to interior ambush; confirms expected enemy response.

rows.en: Well, it's only to be expected, really.
rows.notes: Saburota answers Koji; casual agreement that the ambush is natural.

rows.en: But there aren't many of them for an ambush... Are there more enemy units inside?
rows.notes: Context: Masato questions the unexpectedly small ambush, answering Koji/Saburota. Decision: restore units referent without specifying unseen enemies.

rows.en: Yes, it looks like there are several high-energy readings on the other side of the wall.
rows.notes: Context: Miku answers Masato with sensor information. Decision: retain several readings and tentative appearance.

rows.en: ...Hokuto, Ginga, do you know the way to the reactor?
rows.notes: Context: Ple Two asks both boys for the reactor route. Decision: use explicit English question without claiming either knows.

rows.en: N-no, not really...
rows.notes: Context: Ginga answers Ple Two sheepishly. Decision: retain stutter and purposeful trailing answer.

rows.en: When we went inside Spiral Castle before, we were so caught up in everything...
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto explains the boys previous visit. Decision: restore shared we, retain unfinished explanation and absorption rather than invent panic.

rows.en: Don't worry about it. If we don't know the way, we can just smash through the walls and go straight to the center.
rows.notes: Context: Sai Saici reassures the boys, then proposes a direct route. Decision: restore shared we; retain conditional, smashing walls and exact center.

rows.en: Heh, you got that right. Besides, that's more our style.
rows.notes: Context: Ryoko agrees with Sai Saici. Decision: restore our group subject and casual tone.

rows.en: But don't let your guard down. There should still be two enemy Machine Generals left.
rows.notes: Context: Vega warns allies despite their confidence. Decision: retain expected two remaining generals, not certainty.

rows.en: I know! Machine Generals or any other bastards, I'll take them all on at once!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga answers Vega with bravado. Decision: convey kishou/konchikishou title-insult soundplay through Machine Generals/bastards pairing; no guessed new title.
uncertain: The Machine General/konchikishou soundplay has no direct English sound equivalent; title and insult meaning preserved.

rows.en: All units! We're finally at the final phase of Operation Screw Nail!
rows.notes: Context: Misato addresses all deployed units. Decision: final phase announcement retains operation title and anticipation.
uncertain: Operation Screw Nail is the glossary-approved source-English loanword title; exact licensed English wording remains unverified.

rows.en: Break through the walls inside Spiral Castle and find the reactor as quickly as you can!
rows.notes: Context: Misato orders allies onward. Decision: keep wall destruction, castle interior, reactor and urgency.

rows.en: So you've shown yourselves, you humans.
rows.notes: Context: Giga Absolute confronts arriving humans. Decision: retain contempt without gendering machine.

rows.en: That's...!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto recognizes Absolute in first use and Witter in second. Decision: deliberate unfinished recognition preserved without name or pronoun gender; source omission retained.

rows.en: It's pompous guy number three!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga recognizes Absolute using his own dismissive numbering. Decision: retain pompous nickname and number three.

rows.en: I won't let you reach Oyakata-sama...!
rows.notes: Context: Absolute blocks allies access to the lord. Decision: preserve glossary fixed title and threat.

rows.en: Despair here as you plummet to your home planet!
rows.notes: Context: Absolute threatens allies with despair and a fall to Earth. Decision: retain source home-planet description, not an invented destination or mechanism.

rows.en: Shut up! We should be saying that to you!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga tries to turn Absolutes threat back. Decision: retain reversal so Asukas correction still makes sense.

rows.en: Hey, what are you saying?! We can't let Spiral Castle fall!
rows.notes: Context: Asuka catches Gingas mistaken reversal. Decision: explicit we cannot let castle fall; preserve her incredulity.

rows.en: Oh, right...!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga realizes Asuka is right. Decision: preserve sudden realization and ellipsis.

rows.en: Anyway, we don't have time to stand around! We're going for a quick strike, a quick strike!
rows.notes: Context: Asuka urges immediate action. Decision: retain no time to dawdle and repeated quick-strike emphasis.

rows.en: Y-yeah!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga obeys Asuka. Decision: retain stutter and force.

rows.en: Heh heh heh, it's futile. As long as we're here protecting Oyakata-sama, you cannot stop this Spiral Castle.
rows.notes: Context: Witter explains obstacle in both approach branches. Decision: preserve guarding Oyakata-sama as condition, no premature identity reveal.

rows.en: What did you say!?
Hey! We know we just have to smash the reactor! We're ignoring the likes of you, ignoring you!
rows.notes: Context: Kaine dismisses generals after Witter speaks. Decision: restore we and keep reactor knowledge plus repeated ignoring taunt.

rows.en: You fools. Unless you defeat us, that will be impossible.
rows.notes: Context: Absolute contradicts Kaines plan. Decision: keep defeat of both generals prerequisite and contempt.

rows.en: What the hell does that mean?!
rows.notes: Context: Kaine demands explanation. Decision: full question with rough register.

rows.en: Could those Machine Generals be responsible for keeping the reactor sealed...?
rows.notes: Context: Rain hypothesizes reactor sealing role. Decision: keep conjecture and trailing uncertainty; no physical force field invented.

rows.en: Then we can't reach the reactor unless we defeat them?!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto confirms implications with Rain. Decision: full conditional question with we subject.

rows.en: Yes, most likely...!
rows.notes: Context: Rain answers Hokuto. Decision: preserve likelihood rather than confirmation as fact.

rows.en: Then we'll just have to break that seal ourselves!
rows.notes: Context: Domon resolves to remove obstruction. Decision: ourselves restores source own hands; full English clause.

rows.en: Ginga, Hokuto! This is where the real test begins!
rows.notes: Context: Domon addresses both boys before combat. Decision: keep turning-point challenge; no unspecified task omitted.

rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.notes: Hokuto responds enthusiastically with a stutter.

rows.en: Hmph... You humans have done well to make it this far.
rows.notes: Context: Witter greets allies in alternate first-contact branch. Decision: retain grudging recognition and contempt.

rows.en: It's pompous guy number two!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga misnumbers Witter. Decision: deliberately keep wrong number two before Hokutos correction.

rows.en: Huh?! We beat that one the other day!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto corrects Ginga, referring to prior defeat. Decision: keep that one neutral and shared we; no name substituted.

rows.en: O-oh, right! Then number one!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga corrects his nickname number. Decision: retain stutter and deliberate number-only fragment; source omission retained.

rows.en: You dare mock me...! I will make this castle your grave!
rows.notes: Context: Witter responds to Ginga mocking its numbered nickname. Decision: preserve threat and irritated register.

rows.en: Hey, hey... Isn't this a little too big for a human grave?
rows.notes: Context: Saburota answers Witter's castle-as-grave threat. Decision: sarcastic size comparison remains a question.

rows.en: Indeed. It could hardly be more of a nuisance to everyone else.
rows.notes: Context: George joins Saburota's sarcasm. Decision: restore complete clause and retain polite register; nuisance concerns others.

rows.en: So let's hurry up and smash it to pieces. With them still in it.
rows.notes: Context: Saburota proposes smashing the castle and enemies within. Decision: colloquial deliberate afterthought retains both destruction targets.

rows.en: W-what do you mean!?
rows.notes: Context: alternate Witter encounter, after Giga Absolute says destroying the reactor is impossible until generals are defeated. Decision: Kaine asks for explanation; stutter kept.

rows.en: Enemy Machine General confirmed down!
rows.notes: Context: bridge confirms general destroyed. Decision: source does not identify which general; no added identity.

rows.en: That should open the way to the reactor. How long until we reach the interception limit?
rows.notes: Context: Ruri concludes the seal is gone and asks Hari for time remaining. Decision: source-short interception limit remains descriptive, without adding Zero Barrier.
uncertain: Provisional licensed wording: interception limit is descriptive source terminology; exact licensed English is unverified.

rows.en: Another two...
rows.notes: Context: Hari begins countdown, interrupted by shaking and separate reused !? row. Decision: preserve two as unfinished number; no guessed completion or unit.
uncertain: Purposeful source omission: interrupted countdown stays two...; continuation/unit not supplied.

rows.notes: Source punctuation-only surprise retained.

rows.en: W-what's that!?
rows.notes: Context: Ginga reacts to shaking. Decision: full startled question.

rows.en: Spiral Castle is shaking!?
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto identifies shaking castle. Decision: statement remains surprised question.

rows.en: But we haven't destroyed the reactor yet!?
rows.notes: Context: Vega reacts to premature shaking. Decision: restore we for allies tasked with destroying reactor.

rows.en: Ngh...! Absolute and Witter have been defeated...!
rows.notes: Context: Castle learns both guardians defeated. Decision: source-short Absolute/Witter retained; neutral passive avoids machine gender.

rows.en: !! #男愛称, everyone! I've pinpointed the reactor's location!
rows.notes: Context: heroine sensor report to protagonist and team. Decision: preserve nickname placeholder and exact location claim.

rows.en: Really?!
rows.notes: Male lead asks whether recognition is genuine.

rows.en: Yes, it looks like the seal has been broken! There's no mistaking this energy reading!
rows.notes: Context: heroine answers reused protagonist confirmation question. Decision: seal is apparent but reading certain; both preserved.

rows.en: I'm sending you the coordinates now!
rows.notes: Context: heroine sends team coordinates. Decision: restore I and you from speaker/task context.

rows.en: Th-that's...!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga spots final enemy. Decision: keep deliberate interrupted recognition without prematurely naming identity.
uncertain: Purposeful source fragment: recognition trails off before enemy identity is revealed.

rows.en: So this is...!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga starts identity phrase, completed by Hokuto. Decision: preserve matching cross-row fragment.
uncertain: Purposeful source fragment: Hokuto completes the identity phrase in the next row.

rows.en: The boss of those pompous jerks!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto completes Ginga's preceding fragment. Decision: source mocking nickname describes boss; no lore expansion.
uncertain: Purposeful source fragment: noun phrase completes Ginga's preceding row.

rows.en: That's... the Lord of Spiral Castle!!
rows.notes: Context: Kirakuni names the revealed enemy. Decision: use canonical Lord of Spiral Castle.

rows.en: Is that thing the castle's reactor itself!?
rows.notes: Context: protagonist asks whether enemy is reactor itself. Decision: neutral that thing/it; no machine gender.

rows.en: Then, if we beat it...!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga infers reactor defeat outcome, completed by Hokuto next row. Decision: keep unfinished conditional.
uncertain: Purposeful source fragment: conditional is completed by Hokuto in the next row.

rows.en: We can stop Spiral Castle!?
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto completes Ginga's conditional. Decision: restore we and retain question.

rows.en: Dendoh, Ogre...! If I must die, this planet will die with me...!!
rows.notes: Context: Castle addresses Dendoh and Ogre, vows shared destruction. Decision: restore self as dying subject; planet dies with it. Canonical Ogre.

rows.en: !? The reactor's energy level...!!
rows.notes: Context: heroine notices energy spike before bridge reports acceleration. Decision: keep alarmed energy-level fragment; no explicit rise before source reveals result.
uncertain: Purposeful source fragment: energy-level alarm has no predicate, preserved before acceleration is reported.

rows.en: What's happening?!
Spiral Castle has accelerated! At this rate, it'll reach the interception limit in four minutes!!
rows.notes: Context: Megumi reports acceleration and revised deadline. Decision: descriptive interception limit only, exact four minutes.
uncertain: Provisional licensed wording: interception limit is descriptive source terminology; exact licensed English is unverified.

rows.en: Wha...!
rows.notes: Context: Haruka's interrupted shock. Decision: unfinished interjection retained.
uncertain: Purposeful source fragment: interrupted surprised interjection retained.

rows.en: What did you say?!
rows.notes: Misato demands clarification, also reused at the energy report.

rows.en: I will not let you destroy me so easily...! I will not, humans...!!
rows.notes: Context: Castle refuses effortless defeat. Decision: source restarts negated predicate for emphasis; second repetition remains purposeful ellipsis.
uncertain: Purposeful source omission: repeated second predicate remains unfinished for emphasis.

rows.en: W-we have to beat that thing in just four more minutes!?
rows.notes: Context: Ple asks about new four-minute requirement. Decision: restore we; startled stutter retained.

rows.en: W-we can't! We had enough trouble just getting this far!!
rows.notes: Context: Mondo doubts feasibility after difficult journey. Decision: restore we and keep all earlier difficulty.

rows.en: But these four minutes could decide Earth's fate. We cannot back down now.
rows.notes: Context: Quattro answers despair with necessity to continue. Decision: modal could preserves source uncertainty about outcome, exact interval.

rows.en: But how on earth are we supposed to beat something that big...!?
rows.notes: Context: Nana doubts how to destroy huge enemy. Decision: restore we and defeat from preceding task; preserve trailing alarm.

rows.en: ...Strength comes from the heart. That's the only way we can do this.
rows.notes: Context: Ginga invokes mother's maxim to answer Nana. Decision: existing central maxim exactly, followed by necessity.
uncertain: Provisional quotation: Strength comes from the heart follows central source-based glossary, not a verified licensed quotation.

rows.notes: Context: Nana asks for explanation of maxim. Decision: surprised interjection.

rows.en: That's what my mom taught me. At times like this, you can find a way through if you have the right attitude.
rows.notes: Context: Ginga explains mother's maxim; Nana next confirms mental defeat must be avoided. Decision: right attitude, not physical mechanism or guaranteed easy victory.

rows.en: Yeah, I think I get it... We can't let ourselves lose heart, right?
rows.notes: Nana answers Ginga about mindset; restored shared we.

rows.en: Yeah. Otherwise, we'll lose even a fight we could've won.
rows.notes: Ginga explains why morale matters; restored we.

rows.en: That's right, Ginga... Strength of heart is true strength.
rows.notes: Kazuya privately affirms Ginga; thought syntax.

rows.en: ...You humans, what do you fight for?
rows.notes: Castle interrogates the human attackers; contempt retained in humans.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Context established from original event and neighboring uses; natural source-faithful speech.

rows.en: Even if you destroy me here, His Majesty the Emperor will surely send a new army to Earth at once...
rows.notes: Castle threatens human attackers; source-short Emperor with honorific His Majesty, no expanded name.

rows.en: Yes... Until you are defeated, until you are wiped out, our Gulfer offensive will never cease...
rows.notes: Defeat and extinction both retained; canonical Gulfer.

rows.en: You humans... The more you fight, the further you plunge into despair...
rows.notes: Human attackers are explicit you; despair retained.

rows.en: You are descending a spiral staircase toward the end...
rows.notes: Continues Castle metaphor; source-short end kept ambiguous rather than predicting a specific event.

rows.en: And yet... Why do you fight? What do you fight for?
rows.notes: Context established from original event and neighboring uses; natural source-faithful speech.

rows.en: Isn't it obvious?! Because we've got something to protect!!
rows.notes: Ginga answers motive but does not reveal the protected thing.

rows.en: What is it that you protect?
rows.notes: Context established from original event and neighboring uses; natural source-faithful speech.

rows.en: It attacked us without even understanding that...!?
rows.notes: Hokuto refers to the genderless Castle; it, not a guessed gender.

rows.en: It's just a machine... It only carries out the orders it's given... It could never understand the human heart.
rows.notes: Jet explains the machine limitation without contradicting his own machine identity; only executes commands.

rows.en: Answer me... What is it that you protect?
rows.notes: Context established from original event and neighboring uses; natural source-faithful speech.

rows.en: That's...!
rows.notes: Purposeful suspended answer retained.

rows.en: I'll tell you after I beat the hell out of you!!
rows.notes: Ginga postpones answer until victory; reveal not imported from earlier listed battle event.

rows.en: 1. Shoot down Lord of Spiral Castle within the turn limit
rows.notes: Victory condition; full Lord of Spiral Castle unit title.

rows.en: 1. Lord of Spiral Castle not down by turn limit@2. GEAR Fighter Dendoh/Knight GEAR Ogre shot down@3. An allied mothership shot down
rows.notes: Failure conditions; either named unit and an allied mothership. Measured draft lines 1/2 at 388/363 px; compressed only overflowing fixed lines to not down by turn limit and slash for either-unit alternatives, preserving identities and either-unit failure.

rows.en: Three minutes until Spiral Castle reaches the interception limit!!
rows.notes: Countdown, three minutes, descriptive interception limit.
uncertain: Exact licensed wording of descriptive interception limit unverified; central campaign term retained.

rows.en: Two minutes until Spiral Castle reaches the interception limit! Please hurry!!
rows.notes: Countdown, two minutes and urgent request.
uncertain: Exact licensed wording of descriptive interception limit unverified; central campaign term retained.

rows.en: Everyone! There's only one minute until Spiral Castle reaches the interception limit!!
rows.notes: Countdown, only one minute, addresses all.
uncertain: Exact licensed wording of descriptive interception limit unverified; central campaign term retained.

rows.en: N-no...! Did we run out of time!?
rows.notes: Timeout failure branch; stutter retained, not blended with subsequent victory branch.

rows.en: Captain, we've successfully destroyed the target!!
rows.notes: Success branch; Megumi reports to captain.

rows.en: Good! All units, withdraw from Spiral Castle immediately!!
rows.notes: Bright orders all units out immediately.

rows.en: Everyone, hurry! You'll get caught in the explosion!!
rows.notes: Misato warns allied pilots of explosion.

rows.en: Distortion Field, maximum output.
rows.notes: Ruri issues terse technical bridge command; intentional command syntax retained.

rows.en: We'll make a rapid withdrawal from this sector while shielding Nahel Argama and our allied units.
rows.notes: Ruri states Nadesico withdrawal and shielding both allies; we for ship and crew.

rows.en: Commander, an incoming transmission from #部隊名!
rows.notes: Aiko addresses commander Shibuya; runtime squad placeholder preserved.

rows.en: Operation Screw Nail was a success! Spiral Castle has been destroyed!
rows.notes: Aiko reports operation success and Castle destruction.
uncertain: Operation Screw Nail licensed English title unverified; central source-loanword term retained.

rows.en: Oh...! They did it!
rows.notes: Shibuya responds to report; they is squad, not guessed individual.

rows.en: Hokuto... Ginga...! And everyone in #部隊名...!
rows.notes: Purposeful emotional vocative fragment retained; no invented thanks or praise.

GEAR HQ reacts anxiously to descent; Aiko and Meteo report to Chief Shibuya. Source silence retained. Preserved source fragment, silence, vocative or interjection; no missing English grammatical subject was introduced.

rows.en: Gozen...!
rows.notes: Shibuya addresses Saionji by source fixed contextual title after reused silence; no name expansion.
uncertain: Gozen fixed contextual title canonical licensed English unestablished; central alias retained.

rows.en: Yes. So Earth is safe for the time being...
rows.notes: Saionji acknowledges temporary safety, not final war victory.

context_review.note: Reviewed all 204 fresh English rows and all 30 fresh flags against original scene neighbors. All 155 reused rows checked: 143 exact defeat templates across 205 actual registration uses and no ordinary uses; the other 12 reused IDs compared in every original use. Source fragments, Oyakata/kettle and Machine General insult soundplay, heart maxim and provisional Operation Screw Nail, Zero Barrier and interception limit wording retained. Fresh row 3 explicitly resolves allied/enemy actors from the preceding question and following pincer inference in final only, preserving the first draft. Only actual draft overflows at fresh 36 (dialogue) and 188 (fixed condition) shortened; all questions, failure conditions and unit alternatives retained. Countdown 3/2/1 and timeout/victory branches remain separate. Six distinct actual Sol 6.1 Medium translators and original source hashes preserved. Source-scoped Hari-to-Harry spoken nickname canonical correction only; complete old-to-new assembly delta independently proved against prior reviewed snapshot. Full Hari Makibi and prefills retained. All actual final widths fit, full drafts unchanged; prior context conclusions remain applicable.
